newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank board meeting ends, no changes announced.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank board meeting ends, no changes announced.

text.p: A board meeting of Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, ended on Tuesday with no changes announced to interest rates, the bank said.
It set its discount rate at an unchanged 2.5 percent for the third consecutive quarter.

The board held a telephone conference at 0800 GMT with its main business to deal with the discount rate which is set at the start of every quarter on the basis of interest rate developments during the preceding quarter.
The bank says the rate is merely a reference rate and not in any way connected to monetary policy.

The rate is computed as an average of the daily market rates for six-month T-bills and five year government bonds, based on a daily fixing in the preceding quarter less 2.5 percentage points, rounded to the nearest whole or half point.
